title: Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty Line Card — Warranted Miles, Term and Tread Depth
content:
The Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty program is sold as six tire lines. Each line's treadwear limited warranty runs for its warranted miles, counted from the odometer on the installation work order, or for its warranty term, counted in calendar months from the purchase date on the tire ticket, and ends at whichever of the two comes first. Tread depth for warranty purposes is read at the lowest main groove of the tire. A line's new-tire tread depth is its original tread depth.

| Line | Warranted miles (personal use) | Warranty term | New-tire (original) tread depth | Wear-out tread depth | Where tread is read |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Touring 40K Treadwear Warranty | 40,000 | 48 months | 10/32 in | 2/32 in | lowest main groove |
| Crestline All-Season 50K Treadwear Warranty | 50,000 | 60 months | 10/32 in | 2/32 in | lowest main groove |
| Crestline Grand Touring 60K Treadwear Warranty | 60,000 | 60 months | 11/32 in | 2/32 in | lowest main groove |
| Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K Treadwear Warranty | 65,000 | 60 months | 14/32 in | 2/32 in | lowest main groove |
| Crestline Premium Touring 75K Treadwear Warranty | 75,000 | 72 months | 11/32 in | 2/32 in | lowest main groove |
| Crestline Ultra Touring 85K Treadwear Warranty | 85,000 | 72 months | 11/32 in | 2/32 in | lowest main groove |

Warranted miles are written above with a thousands separator; the figures are 40000, 50000, 60000, 65000, 75000, 85000 miles in line order.

### Who each line is sold for

Every line is sold only as new tires purchased and installed at a Crestline store, and only for the vehicle classes listed on its line card:

| Line | Vehicle classes the line is sold for | Warranty follows the vehicle to a new owner |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Touring 40K Treadwear Warranty | passenger car, minivan | No |
| Crestline All-Season 50K Treadwear Warranty | passenger car, SUV/CUV, minivan | No |
| Crestline Grand Touring 60K Treadwear Warranty | passenger car, SUV/CUV, minivan | No |
| Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K Treadwear Warranty | light truck, SUV/CUV, commercial van | No |
| Crestline Premium Touring 75K Treadwear Warranty | passenger car, SUV/CUV, minivan | No |
| Crestline Ultra Touring 85K Treadwear Warranty | passenger car, SUV/CUV | No |

No line's treadwear warranty is transferable: on every line the warranty stays with the original purchaser's set and does not pass to a buyer of the vehicle.

### Reading the line card

- **Usable tread** on a line is the new-tire depth less the wear-out depth: 8/32 in on the 40K and 50K lines, 9/32 in on the 60K, 75K and 85K lines, and 12/32 in on the Highway Terrain LT 65K line.
- **Warranted miles versus term:** the warranty ends at the earlier of the two; a set that reaches its line's warranted miles before its term ends has reached the end of its treadwear warranty on mileage, and a set whose term ends first has reached it on age.
